matches.note: Caldwell tried to flee before the bell and was shoved back to the ring by Damian Payne; Roman Anderson then attacked Payne at ringside during the match. Afterward Payne fought off Anderson and sent him to the back.

matches.how: time-limit draw, with Harper appearing to score the pinfall in the same instant the bell rang for time
matches.note: Afterward Roman Anderson knocked Harper out with brass knuckles he had smuggled past the referee earlier in the match; Kagedo then ran in to attack the fallen Harper further, but was chased off by Adam Jennings and the O'Malley Brothers.

matches.how: disqualification, after Purgatory's own recurring hooded manager speared Marcus O'Malley with a spinebuster
matches.note: Anthony O'Malley made his own return from a September injury at Kagedo's hands. Afterward Purgatory and their manager beat the O'Malleys down three-on-one until Adam Jennings ran out to help, only for Kagedo to chair both Jennings and the O'Malleys; Kevin Simmons then emerged and stared Kagedo down before security separated them.

evidence.source: The broadcast's own dateline and match-by-match commentary.
evidence.note: Posted 9 December 2005; every result is stated explicitly in the broadcast's own text.

notes: A cold open finds Classy Joey Boy attacked and hospitalized in the Sam's Town parking garage; the broadcast names Lark Fenriz and Mike Bisignano as suspects seen fleeing the scene, though no one witnessed the attack itself. A separate backstage vignette shows Stevie Knight make an unsuccessful pass at Jessica Jennings. Chris Wheeling meets privately with Rod Beauty over rumors that the VXW Tag Team Championship might be stripped from Hot Property after Austin Lee pinned his own partner Stevie Knight in the Rage In The Cage cage match at Phear Phantastic 2005; Wheeling confirms on-air, and the broadcast's own commentator concurs, that Hot Property walked out of that match with the titles and no stripping will occur. Wheeling closes the broadcast with a lengthy year-end promo alongside Thunder Valenkov and Hot Property.

name: Christmas Comes Early

date.source: The broadcast's own header ('VXW Presents: Christmas Comes Early, December 24, 2005'); posted to the newsgroup 27 December 2005 under the subject line's own spelling, 'Chrismas Comes Early.'

matches.how: pinfall (a somersault legdrop by Roman Anderson, the Leap Of Faith, on Iyasu Saku)
matches.note: Billed as a Newcomer Of The Year audition for all four men; David Xavier seconded Sturgis. Afterward Kyle Sturgis turned on his own winning partner, planting Anderson with a Mount Sturgis Driver.

matches.how: submission (the Cardinal Sin, by Synn on an unconscious Kenny Kidd)
matches.note: Team Brittania no-showed the charity card, so the Beauty Brothers paired Kenny Kidd and Billy Bones with Tap Out City against Team Essington (fielding Mr. Jefferson and Mr. Smith) and Purgatory, with Purgatory's own recurring hooded manager again at ringside. A debuting Tanara Skott chaired Kidd to set up the finish; afterward a debuting Sebastian ran in to chair PsyKlone and Synn in retaliation, demanding 'the head of the Equalizer.'

matches.how: pinfall, both men crashing through a table together off the top rope, the referee ruling Payne landed on top, in a Table For Two match
matches.note: For the VXW Spin The Wheel Championship; Payne retains.

matches.how: pinfall (a small package) over Lark Fenriz, in a Triple Threat Elimination match; Arron Iron was eliminated first, pinned by Fenriz with Sammael
matches.note: A non-title match. Rod Beauty came to ringside during a Fenriz cover; Fenriz spat in his face and Beauty responded by dropping him throat-first across the top rope, setting up Bisignano's own finish.

matches.how: a Tornado Tag Team title match ending when Anthony O'Malley rolled up Austin Lee for a three-count in the same instant Stevie Knight pinned Marcus O'Malley with a title belt shot; the referee counted both falls, then left the ring without a ruling
matches.note: For the VXW Tag Team Championship; no official decision was rendered and Hot Property remained champions. Chris Wheeling and Jessica Jennings were handcuffed together at ringside per Rob Beauty's own stipulation; the referee was Jon Gale.

matches.how: double countout, with Justin Harper tied in the ropes and Thunder Valenkov and Adam Jennings brawling outside as the count ran out
matches.note: Billed The Match Made In Hell. Kagedo refused to tag in for most of the match, briefly walking out entirely, before returning to save Valenkov from Jennings's own Single Leg Boston Crab. Postmatch, a man dressed as Santa Claus broke up a continued attack on Harper and, after Chris Wheeling slapped him, unmasked as Kevin Simmons and dropped Wheeling with the Durham Deathdrop.

evidence.source: The broadcast's own recap-style report, match by match.
evidence.note: Self-dated 24 December 2005 in the broadcast's own header; posted to the newsgroup 27 December 2005. Every result is stated explicitly in the report's own text.

notes: A special untelevised charity card, opened by Lean Darlene Orion in a Santa outfit and billed for various Las Vegas homeless and children's charities. Venue given as 'Sam's Club,' departing from the promotion's own usual Sam's Town, without further explanation in the text. Rob Beauty came to the ring with Santa Claus during intermission to distribute gifts and thank the crowd.

date.source: The post's own dateline.

matches.how: the referee stopped the match and awarded it to Purgatory after a returning Sebastian ran in from the crowd and chaired down Synn and PsyKlone, moments after PsyKlone had Kenny Kidd set up for a chokeslam
matches.note: Originally billed as a six-on-two match, but Team Brittania failed to show for a second straight time, so officials made it a triple threat instead. Sebastian's chair carried the words "This One Is For The Equalizer." All three members of Team Essington attacked the Rodeo Boys afterward until security restored order.

matches.how: pinfall (a Running Powerslam followed by the Snakebite)
matches.note: Ckris Killa's debut. Cobra, who has been helping train the VXW Academy's students, shook hands with Johnny Stone before the match.

matches.how: won three falls to two in an Iron Man match that reached sudden death after regulation time expired with the score tied 2-2, the extra fall a small package after Harper reversed Kagedo's own Endgame powerbomb
matches.note: Kagedo opened the scoring with a chair shot that cost him a disqualification fall, then evened it with a Dragon Suplex; Harper tied it again with a small package off a crucifix reversal. Afterward a returning Kevin Simmons shook Harper's hand; Kagedo is now due to face Simmons at Ghost Town Blues.

matches.how: pinfall (a Chokebomb onto a steel stop sign) over Arron Iron, inside a five-way Pentagon Of Pain cage match fought with weapons
matches.note: Omega opened the match by splitting Damian Payne's head open with a two-by-four; Mike Bisignano broke up an early Omega cover before Omega dumped him outside the cage and beat his head against it. Afterward Cobra ran in from the back and brawled with Omega until security separated them.

matches.how: won a scored Irish Street Fight 12-9 to retain the VXW Tag Team Championship, the deciding points scored when two of Chris Wheeling's own hired men drove Marcus O'Malley through a table
matches.note: No pinfall, submission or countout could decide the match: a weapon shot scored a point, driving an opponent through a table scored three, and hitting one's own partner cost a point. Jessica Jennings DDT'd a taunting Chris Wheeling on the outside, and Thunder Valenkov ran in to Thunder Bomb Marcus O'Malley onto a bed of barbed wire.

matches.how: pinfall, after Hot Property's Stevie Knight and Austin Lee ran in and hit Jennings with a Property Boom while the match's own referee lay knocked out, letting a second referee count Valenkov's cover, retaining the VXW 24 Hour Championship
matches.note: Jennings choke-slammed Valenkov, hit a Double Underhook DDT and appeared to have the champion pinned, but the referee had been knocked out earlier in the match and there was no one to make the count.

date.source: The post's own dateline.

matches.how: submission (a sleeperhold)
matches.note: A VXW Academy match; Arron Iron and Iyasu Saku were both unable to appear on the show, so two of the Academy's own students filled the slot instead.

matches.how: submission (a Dragon Sleeper), after Omega gave Payne two minutes to finish him or face a broken neck and did not fight back until the time expired
matches.note: Omega refused to pin Payne, following the submission instead with a Gorilla Press before Cobra ran in from the crowd; Damian Payne then slid in and big-booted both men down. Officials broke it up before Omega could use a chair. Backstage afterward, Damian Payne told Lean Darlene Orion he had attacked Matt Payne to send a message to Cobra.

matches.how: pinfall (Utter Insanity, PsyKlone powerbombing Synn onto a fallen Sebastian), after Sebastian's own back body drop counter knocked out the referee and let PsyKlone run in for a two-on-one beatdown
matches.note: Sebastian's in-ring return; billed as the VXW's first-ever 24 Hour Champion and a three-time holder of that title, he came out of retirement to challenge the mystery figure behind Purgatory, though that figure was not who he expected.

matches.how: pinfall (a Senton by Mr. Jefferson off a Mr. Jones shoulder lift, with Mr. Smith holding Kenny Kidd's ankles down for the count), after the referee missed a tag Billy Bones had made while distracted by Mr. Smith on the ring apron
matches.note: Mr. Smith worked the match mostly from the outside, with Mr. Jefferson and Mr. Jones taking the fall in the ring for Team Essington.

matches.how: disqualification, after Omega ran in, pulled Cobra off Anderson and struck Anderson himself
matches.note: Anderson made his usual slow entrance, pulling t-shirts from his own pants for the crowd. Cobra dominated for most of the match before Omega's run-in ended it; Omega and Cobra had a tense stare-down afterward, with Spin The Wheel Champion Damian Payne's own tensions with both men still simmering.

matches.how: pinfall (the Hyperdrive)
matches.note: Chris Wheeling's own interference backfired twice, a hired heavy's foot-trip and a low blow behind the referee's back both failing to put Jennings away; Jennings also yanked Wheeling into the ring by his own neck brace during the match. Afterward Wheeling's two hired men beat down an exhausted Jennings until the O'Malley Brothers ran in to clear the ring; Jennings then publicly challenged Chris Wheeling and Thunder Valenkov for a future 24 Hour Championship shot.

matches.how: won by disqualification and retained the VXW Television Championship, after Kagedo ran in and chaired down both men; the referee had counted a Harper pinfall off the resulting cover, but promotion co-owner Rod Beauty overturned the result to a disqualification win for the champion
matches.note: Fenriz opened the show by revealing a captive valet, Vicki, as Rod Beauty's own missing companion, held under his control for months, and offered to release her if Beauty handed over his own share of the promotion; no answer was given on this broadcast. Kagedo attacked both men with the chair after Fenriz had earlier waved off his own attempted help.

date.source: The post's own dateline.

matches.how: pinfall (a Backbreaker/Guillotine Legdrop combination), after Mr. Jones chokeslammed one Diablo and Mr. Smith pulled the other off the ring apron
matches.note: A tryout match for the masked VXW Academy lucha team Los Diablos, whose speed advantage was quickly neutralized by Team Essington's own numbers.

matches.how: won by count-out, after Killa, having narrowly escaped the Good and Evil Crossface, rolled to the floor and left for the back before the referee's count ran out
matches.note: A rematch of the pair's debut encounter on New Years Eve Of Destruction, this time decided without a fall.

matches.how: pinfall (a pinning combination by Miles McKinley on Synn), after PsyKlone's own blindside attack forced an illegal tag
matches.note: Sebastian's own mystery partner, a returning G-Gangsta, was chaired down and attacked backstage by Purgatory before the match, forcing VXW co-owner Rod Beauty to name debuting Academy student Miles McKinley as a last-minute replacement; McKinley wrestled in a kilt and a bright red afro, pinning Synn for a surprise debut win.

matches.how: pinfall (a Chokebomb), in under a minute
matches.note: A Spin The Wheel Non-Title Match; the VXW Spin The Wheel Championship was not at stake. Afterward Roman "Money" Anderson came to the ring and mocked the departing Payne.

matches.how: submission (the Durham Deathlock)
matches.note: Anderson, complaining in the ring that the locker room was scared of him after his own night off, was answered by a returning Kevin Simmons; Kagedo watched the finish from the stage in a staredown with Simmons.

matches.how: submission (the Hyper Extension)
matches.note: Knight attacked Jennings from behind after the bell; Jennings shrugged him off and flipped off Chris Wheeling on his way out.

Omega had Cobra locked in the Anklelock From Hell and would not release it even after the referee tried to physically pull him off; Damian Payne then ran in and brawled with Omega until VXW security separated them, and the match was never restarted.

matches.how: pinfall (Anthony O'Malley's own Leap of Faith)
matches.note: A No Disqualification Tornado match, ordered on the spot by Rod Beauty; ring steps and a chair were used freely on both sides, Anthony O'Malley busted open by the chair. Afterward Chris Wheeling sent Hot Property to the ring and a four-on-two beatdown of the O'Malleys began; Adam Jennings ran in and hit Hyper Drive on both hired hands, the VXW 24 Hour Champion Thunder Valenkov then attacked Jennings, and Justin Harper and Kevin Simmons ran in to even the numbers, forcing Wheeling to pull his side back toward the dressing room.

matches.how: pinfall over Kagedo, not champion Lark Fenriz, to win the VXW Spin The Wheel Television Championship — a referee bump let Kagedo chair down both other men before a returning Kevin Simmons ran in and knocked Kagedo out cold with his own bat, letting Harper hit a Spinebuster on Fenriz and then cover the fallen Kagedo for the three count
matches.note: Fenriz opened the match still champion; the title changed hands on Kevin Simmons's own interference rather than any finishing move by Harper.

date.source: The post's own dateline.

matches.note: Team Essington's four masked members — Mr. Jones, Mr. Jefferson, Mr. Smith and a newly introduced fourth man, Mr. Sal — ran in with two-by-fours and put down all four combatants before Chad Essington took the microphone to demand his own team's shot at the VXW Tag Team Championship. VXW co-owner Rod Beauty responded by booking a fatal four-way at Ghost Town Blues among the Rodeo Boys, Team Brittania, and Team Essington split into two teams.

matches.how: a Missile Dropkick pinned Tyler Shaw
matches.note: Roddy Barber, using mat skills to ground his opponents, took the early lead before McKinley's own late dropkick decided it.

matches.how: submission (the Beauty Breaker)
matches.note: An impromptu Scott Starring Medal Challenge match: Ric Beauty, wearing Scott Starring's own Twelve Days Tournament medals around his neck, interrupted the previous match's celebration and dared one of the four Academy competitors to try to win them back.

matches.how: pinfall (a schoolboy by Matt Payne on Omega)
matches.note: Cobra hot-tagged Academy student Matt Payne, who pinned the legal man Omega for the win. Afterward Damian Payne broke through VXW security with chair shot after chair shot on Matt Payne and Cobra, while Omega refused to release an Anklelock From Hell on Matt Payne; Matt Payne's own ankle was seriously injured and will require surgery.

matches.how: submission (a Shoulder Breaker into a deep Fujiwara Armbar)
matches.note: A rematch Saku himself requested despite already owning the win by count-out on Winter War II. Afterward Saku called out Omega, Damian Payne and Cobra by name and demanded a hardcore match against all three at Ghost Town Blues.

matches.how: submission (the Cedar Rapid Deathlock)
matches.note: Billed a non-title match despite Harper's own new VXW Spin The Wheel Television Championship; Anderson spent much of it chasing down a fan who threw back a t-shirt he had tossed into the crowd. Between matches, a returning Lark Fenriz — still seething over losing that same title on Winter War II — challenged VXW co-owner Rod Beauty to a ladder match at Ghost Town Blues over Vicki, the valet he has held captive for months; Beauty accepted, with Vicki's freedom on the line against Fenriz's own demand for Beauty's forty-nine percent ownership stake in the promotion should Fenriz win.

matches.how: pinfall, after Thunder Valenkov stopped himself from breaking up Marcus O'Malley's own cover at the last instant, apparently still angered at Chris Wheeling
matches.note: Rod Beauty billed the match with the winning side earning a shot at the VXW Tag Team and 24 Hour Championships at Ghost Town Blues. One of Chris Wheeling's hired hands blindsided Adam Jennings with the 24 Hour Championship belt while the referee's attention was elsewhere; the hired hands later ran back in with the tag title belts but missed their target. Afterward a furious Wheeling ordered Valenkov to finish off Marcus O'Malley; Jennings shoved Wheeling down, and a brawl involving Hyper Drives on both hired hands, Stevie Knight and Austin Lee followed before Wheeling announced that Valenkov's own Twenty-Four Hour Championship defense against Jennings at Ghost Town Blues will be contested inside a Russian Cage Match.

date.source: The post's own dateline.

matches.stipulation: Battle royal, the winner naming a title shot of his choosing at St Patricks Day Massacre
matches.note: Eliminated in order: Mr. Smith; Billy Bones and Sebastian (both by Omega); Mr. Jones (by Synn and PsyKlone together); Mr. Sal and Mr. Jefferson (both by Justin and Simon Davidson); Iyasu Saku (by Lark Fenriz); Damian Payne (by Austin Lee, a low blow); Anthony O'Malley (by Kenny Kidd); PsyKlone (by Omega); Kenny Kidd (by Justin and Simon Davidson); Marcus O'Malley (pulled out by a returning Stevie Knight, who had himself been knocked to the floor earlier without being eliminated); Austin Lee (by Justin and Simon Davidson); Justin Harper and Lark Fenriz together (by Synn); Cobra (by Omega); Synn and Simon Davidson together (by Omega); Justin Davidson (by Omega, a chokeslam). Down to Omega and Roman Anderson, Anderson tried to leave the match rather than keep competing, but Omega dragged him back in; WILD Freestyle Champion Mike Bisignano then ran in and struck Omega with his own title belt, letting Anderson dropkick Omega out for the win.

matches.how: submission (the Beauty Breaker), in seconds
matches.note: The Ric Beauty Scott Starring Medal Challenge: Ric Beauty invited Lean Darlene Orion, not a wrestler, in Scott Starring's own place, then forced her into the hold before Starring could answer the open challenge himself.

matches.how: pinfall (Utter Insanity, PsyKlone covering Tyler Shaw), after PsyKlone had already knocked Joey Young off the ring apron
matches.note: A VXW Academy tryout for Johnny Stone's own students. Afterward, a debuting Stan Klenski and an unnamed larger partner ran in with Sebastian to clothesline Purgatory from the ring; Sebastian again demanded a match with the absent Equalizer, addressing Purgatory's own valet, Tanara Skott.

matches.how: pinfall (the Albion Smasher, Justin Davidson covering Kenny Kidd)
matches.note: Simon Davidson kicked out of the Rodeo Boys' own Eight Second Ride and broke up a Billy Bones save attempt before the finish. The winner earns a VXW Tag Team Championship shot at St Patricks Day Massacre. Team Essington, originally also booked for this match, were pulled after all four members were attacked backstage before it, leaving it a straight team-on-team contest.

matches.stipulation: Six Shooter Graveyard Match: six open graves around the ring covered in glass, a man eliminated by falling through the glass
matches.note: Roman Anderson tried to forfeit into a promo on his own battle-royal win rather than compete, but Omega threw him through the glass regardless for the first elimination. Cobra and Damian Payne fell through a cracked grave together after Justin Harper's own shovel shot to Payne sent him stumbling into them, though Omega rolled clear before falling in himself. Iyasu Saku and Omega then went through another grave's glass together during a suplex; Harper alone held on at the edge to survive and win. A bloodied Omega returned afterward to spinebuster Harper through a further grave in a post-match assault.

matches.how: Fenriz freed Vicki, suspended above the ring in a cage, first, in a ladder match
matches.note: For Vicki's own freedom and Rod Beauty's own 49 percent ownership stake in the VXW. Vicki, presented as Fenriz's captive, detonated a hidden explosive that knocked Beauty from the ladder as he opened her cage, revealing the rescue as a set-up; Fenriz then freed her himself to win the match, Vicki's own stake, and the company share.

matches.how: Anthony O'Malley unhooked the suspended title belts while Stevie Knight, holding Anthony in a leglock beside him atop the other ladder, lost his grip and fell, in a Tables Ladders and Chairs match
matches.note: The O'Malley Brothers win the VXW Tag Team Championship for the first time, ending Hot Property's own reign. Wheeling's Thugs briefly interfered three-on-one against Marcus O'Malley before the referee threatened to award the match by forfeit, forcing Chris Wheeling to call them off.

matches.how: pinfall (the Hyperdrive, a reversal of Valenkov's own attempted Thunder Bomb), inside a Russian Cage Match with no ropes or turnbuckles and a packed-earth floor, winnable only by pinfall, a failed ten count, or the white flag
matches.note: Adam Jennings wins the VXW Twenty-Four Hour Championship for the first time, ending Thunder Valenkov's own reign; both men were bleeding freely by the finish, and Jennings twice refused the white flag's offer of a stoppage. Chris Wheeling entered the cage afterward to assault the fallen Jennings before Jessica Jennings intervened and was struck down herself; the newly-crowned O'Malley Brothers then helped Jennings from the cage.

matches.how: last man standing, Kevin Simmons beating the referee's ten count after Kagedo failed to answer it himself
matches.note: An unsanctioned Last Man Standing brawl fought without VXW sanction or a title at stake, closing nearly four years of on-screen enmity; Kagedo broke Simmons's own arm early with a ring-steps assault. 'Outlaw' Morris Bass interfered mid-match, striking down both men with a Widowmaker on Simmons and a big boot to Kagedo's own knee, before leaving; the finish came only after an exhausted Kagedo himself failed to beat a count.

matches.how: pinfall, a crucifix pin caught coming out of Sebastian's own Sex You Out Boston Crab
matches.note: Tanara Skott and Purgatory's appearance on the stage broke Sebastian's hold, letting McKinley roll him up.

matches.how: disqualification, after Mr. Sal punched the referee during Team Essington's four-on-two beatdown of Los Diablos
matches.note: Afterward Chad Essington challenged whoever had attacked Team Essington backstage at Ghost Town Blues to a match at St Patricks Day Massacre.

matches.how: pinfall, PsyKlone's two-handed chokeslam on Klenski
matches.note: Two masked men, later identified only as Rigor and Mortis, emerged from beneath the ring during the match and beat down Sebastian at ringside before Purgatory's win, apparently answering a phone call Tanara Skott had made.

matches.how: disqualification, special guest referee Justin Harper called for the bell after Omega shoved him aside to keep attacking Saku outside the ring
matches.note: Omega beat down both Saku and Harper afterward, driving Saku through a ring barrier; Saku was diagnosed with a concussion at UMC Medical Center.

matches.how: cage escape, Cobra pushed off with his boots as Payne stood near the open door, sending the champion backward through it
matches.note: VXW Spin The Wheel Championship. Lean Darlene Orion's spin of the wheel set the escapes-only steel cage stipulation before the bell; Cobra's win ends Payne's own reign as the title's inaugural champion.

date.source: The post's own dateline.

evidence.source: The broadcast's own dateline and match-by-match commentary.
evidence.note: Posted 20 March 2006 under a (VWX) subject tag; body text, participants, and posting address confirm the same VXW broadcast series. Every match result is stated explicitly in the broadcast's own text.

matches.note: A number one contenders tournament opening bout. Both men brawled outside the ring until the referee's count expired; security was ordered to remain at ringside for the rest of the tournament.

matches.how: disqualification, after Chad Essington distracted the referee and Mr. Sal chaired Heavy J, then two more Team Essington members entered illegally
matches.note: KAOS, billed as veterans of the Dog Days and Twelve Days Tournaments, made their VXW debut ambushing Team Essington from the crowd before the bell.

matches.how: pinfall, a DDT
matches.note: A number one contenders tournament bout; Sal advances for Essington Sports Inc.

matches.how: pinfall, a belly to belly throw
matches.note: VXW Television Championship, Taipei Death Match. New 49 percent owner Lark Fenriz decreed the stipulation before the bell, having both men dip their hands in glue and broken glass; both bled heavily throughout.

matches.how: submission, an Ankle Lock after Omega broke free of his own bound wrists and hit a Spinebuster
matches.note: A number one contenders tournament bout, contested as a handicap match by Lark Fenriz's own decree: Omega wrestled with his hands tied behind his back and no tag partner allowed for Sebastian. Omega broke Sebastian's ankle after the finish, ending Sebastian's own night early; Omega advances in the tournament.

matches.how: disqualification, after Anthony O'Malley struck Simon Davidson with a chair
matches.note: VXW Tag Team Championship. The O'Malleys retain the titles on the disqualification, their first defense since winning them at Ghost Town Blues.

matches.how: pinfall, the Last Stop followed by a Chokebomb
matches.note: VXW Spin The Wheel Championship rematch. Payne regains the title he lost to Cobra at Xtreme Machine I.

matches.how: pinfall, the Hyper Drive
matches.note: VXW Twenty-Four Hour Championship. The returning "Outlaw" Morris Bass, back from a ninety-day suspension, accompanied Chris Wheeling and Valenkov to the ring and tried to chair Jennings; Jennings ducked, Bass struck Valenkov instead, and Jennings clotheslined Bass from the ring before the finish.

date.source: The post's own dateline; the broadcast's own text does not restate a calendar date.

matches.how: pinfall, a diving Fat Man Splash off the top rope
matches.note: Opens the tournament's own first round, a shot at Adam "The Hype" Jennings's Twenty-Four Hour Championship at The Gauntlet.

matches.how: disqualification, after Dynamo shoved the referee
matches.note: Team Essington (Mr. Sal, Mr. Jones, Mr. Smith) then mobbed Dynamo four-on-one until Heavy J made the save with a two-by-four.

matches.how: pinfall, rolling through his own brother Anthony's missed flying cross body
pinfall, brass knuckles to the head
matches.note: Stan Klenski's appearance at ringside drew PsyKlone away from a top-rope Anderson just before the knockout blow.

matches.how: pinfall, a loaded roll-of-quarters punch
matches.note: Valet Kelly DeClair's ringside interference (a distraction, then a slipped roll of quarters) turned the finish; the referee questioned it but allowed the pin to stand.

matches.how: count-out, Synn failing to beat the referee's ten count after being driven head first into the ring steps
matches.note: A rematch of the two men's own double count-out at St Patricks Day Massacre.

matches.how: pinfall, the Widowmaker
matches.note: Chris Wheeling's ringside interference (an ankle grab, then goading Valenkov into a chair shot) backfired when Valenkov kicked the chair away; Twenty-Four Hour Champion Adam Jennings watched the match from ringside without entering it.

date.source: The post's own dateline; the broadcast's own text does not restate a calendar date.

evidence.note: Posted 10 April 2006; every match result is stated explicitly in the broadcast's own text.

matches.note: Declared a double disqualification after Mr. Sal, Mr. Jones, Mr. Smith and Chad Essington interfered for Team Essington and Dynamo ran in for KAOS; both men were eliminated from the number one contenders tournament.

matches.how: pinfall, brass knuckles with his feet braced on the ropes
pinfall, the Widowmaker
matches.note: Twenty-Four Hour Champion Adam Jennings watched from ringside and gave Sal a warning that let Bass kick out of a schoolboy near-fall; after the bell, Jennings chokeslammed Bass with the Hyper Drive when Bass refused a handshake.

matches.how: forfeit, Sebastian (appearing on screen from his hospital bed) ordering Papa Joe Popovich and Stan Klenski from the ring before the bell, followed by a referee's ten count
matches.note: Klenski and Popovich then beat Synn unconscious backstage.

matches.how: pinfall, a top-rope Beauty Bomb
matches.note: A non-tournament exhibition bout for Scott Starring's own Twelve Days Tournament medals, which Ric Beauty already held.

matches.how: pinfall, reversing a Justin Davidson small package after Davidson landed a low blow
matches.note: Valet Kelly DeClair's ringside interference (poking Payne in the eyes to block a Tornado DDT, then a late distraction) nearly cost Payne the match.

matches.how: put Jones through a table with a Hurricanrana in a tables match
matches.note: Billed on-air as a defense of the VXW Spin The Wheel Championship, with Mr. Sal and Mr. Jefferson interfering for Jones before Heavy J and Dynamo evened the numbers. No document in the held record records a title change from Damian Payne, who regained the belt twelve days after losing it at St Patricks Day Massacre, to Cobra between that show and this one; recorded here as an ordinary match, and the championship's own held reign is not altered, matching the wing's own established precedent for an unsupported on-air title claim (Mike Bisignano's Television Championship claim).

date.source: The post's own dateline; the broadcast's own text does not restate a calendar date of its own.

evidence.note: Posted 17 April 2006; every match result is stated explicitly in the broadcast's own text.

matches.how: pinfall, a Soviet Judo Suplex into the Thunder Bomb
matches.note: Valenkov hit further Thunder Bombs after the bell until Johnny Stone confronted him at ringside; Roddy Barber and Tyler Shaw ran in from the academy locker room and were clotheslined and spinebustered in turn. Chris Wheeling then pulled Valenkov away, warning Stone against interfering again.

matches.how: pinfall, Mr. Sal's schoolboy on Cobra with a handful of trunks while the referee was pulled to the apron
matches.note: A four-on-three match; Team Essington isolated Cobra early with a mob attack before Heavy J and Dynamo pulled off two of the four.

matches.how: count-out, the Polish Powers walking to the back
matches.note: Before the bell, Stan Klenski presented Purgatory a suitcase holding $200,000, an offer from Sebastian for The Equalizer to face him at The Gauntlet, giving Synn and PsyKlone until The Hype IV to decide; neither man took the money, and the Polish Powers left without contesting the match.

matches.how: pinfall, after the referee accidentally struck Payne with a chair meant for Omega
matches.note: A number one contenders tournament final-four bout.

matches.how: pinfall, the Widowmaker
matches.note: A number one contenders tournament final-four bout.

matches.how: count-out, Adam Jennings leaving the ring to tend to a chair-shotted Justin Harper
matches.note: Omega taunted Justin Harper over an open contract via the video screen, then vaulted the barrier and chair-shotted Harper from behind.

Anderson drove Fenriz off with a chair after Warren fled and hid under the ring, and a returning Foodstamp squared off with Anderson until VXW security separated everyone; no decision was reached.

matches.how: count-out, Foodstamp brawling with Roman Anderson at ringside
matches.note: Foodstamp dominated, setting up a Twisting Senton Bomb and later a table spot on Klenski, but Roman Anderson and John Manning ran in to stop him putting Klenski through the table; Foodstamp and Anderson traded punches outside the ring until Lark Fenriz ran in and clotheslined Manning away, and the referee counted Foodstamp out.

matches.how: submission, the Anklelock From Hell
matches.note: Billed as a tag match, Omega instead challenged Young to a direct one-on-one match in the ring, sending his own manager Richard Masterson away and telling Thunder Valenkov to leave as well; Young sent his own corner man Cobra away in kind. Young fought hard, hitting a Spear off a hip toss, but tapped out to the Anklelock From Hell; Cobra ran back in with a chair to break the hold after the bell had already rung, and Masterson, Valenkov, and Chris Wheeling pulled Omega from the ring.

matches.how: disqualification, Kevin Simmons striking Marcus O'Malley with a chair
matches.note: The O'Malleys ambushed Bass and manager Kevin Simmons on their own way to the ring, working over Bass with a Monkey Flip into a Modified Powerbomb before Simmons climbed onto the apron; Simmons then chair-shotted Marcus O'Malley in front of the referee for the disqualification. Simmons and Bass followed up after the bell, hitting Anthony with a Durham Deathdrop and Marcus with a Widowmaker before leaving for the airport.

matches.how: disqualification, Foodstamp throwing the referee over the top rope
matches.note: Billed as Protectors of Truth, Fenriz and Foodstamp beat down Young and Rogers and kept going after the disqualification, bringing a table into the ring, until a returning Kenny Kidd and Billy Bones ran in and drove them off.

matches.how: pinfall, the Starmaker (a double underhook piledriver), inside a No Disqualification, No Count Out match
matches.note: Kris and Brian Dierdorf and valet Delila ambushed a returning Equalizer three-on-one at Sebastian's own signal, clotheslining him with a jagged piece of a broken table before the Dierdorfs hit their own Pulverizer and Sebastian finished him.

matches.how: disqualification, Marcus O'Malley taking valet Delila's own riding crop from Brian Dierdorf in front of the referee
matches.note: The O'Malleys worked over Kris Dierdorf's arm until Delila slipped Brian the riding crop behind the referee's back to welt up Anthony's.

matches.how: submission, the Anklelock From Hell
matches.note: Omega refused to release the hold after the bell; manager Chad Essington couldn't pull him off, and a returning Matt Payne, a former VXW student, ran in and rocked Omega with strikes before Omega shoved manager Richard Masterson into Payne's own charge, taking a Spear meant for Omega.

matches.how: pinfall, John Manning's schoolboy on champion Bass, after a returning Adam Jennings appeared on the stage and distracted him mid-cover
matches.note: New VXW Tag Team Champions, billed afterward as The Outcasts.

A three-way VXW 24 Hour/Television Championship match under special rules: Valenkov could only defend his own 24 Hour Championship (not lose the Television title), McKinley could win only the Television Championship, and Cobra could lose the Television title or win the 24 Hour Championship. Sebastian armed McKinley with a chair to knock out Valenkov; Omega and Matt Payne then brawled into the match from outside, and the referee called for the bell without a decision as VXW President Val Beauty arrived on stage.

matches.how: count-out, Paul Joseph Warren refusing to answer the bell
matches.note: Warren, pitching his own HUGS violence-reduction program, told The Equalizer he wouldn't fight a man still hurting from Sebastian's own New Year's Eve of Destruction beatdown and walked off before the bell.

matches.how: disqualification, Brian Dierdorf and valet Delila jumping into the ring for a three-on-one attack
matches.note: Billed as the top-contending Dierdorfs' own long-awaited shot at proving themselves against the new champions, though no title was formally contested in this singles bout; The Dierdorfs ambushed Anderson and John Manning from the crowd before the bell and Kris stood in as their own entrant. Manning cleared the ring afterward with his own title belt.

matches.how: pinfall, the Eight Second Ride
matches.note: The returning Rodeo Boys, billing this as their own last ride, challenged the O'Malleys, Team Brittania and Hot Property afterward to a one-night tournament for VXW tag team supremacy.

matches.how: disqualification, a returning Equalizer chairing Payne in the face
matches.note: Billed 'Sadistic Insanity' Damian Payne, wrestling a grudge match after being passed over for the VXW Wrestlebowl team; the referee had already tossed Sebastian's own cronies from ringside before the bell. The Equalizer's own chair shot, aimed at revenge for Sebastian's New Year's Eve of Destruction beatdown, struck Payne instead, but the referee still ruled the outside interference a disqualification in Payne's favor.

matches.how: disqualification, Bass low-blowing Jennings
matches.note: Jennings hit the Hyper Driver on Bass moments after the disqualification, both men distracted mid-brawl by a taunting pre-recorded video insert from a returning Travis LaGrange.

matches.how: pinfall, Matt Payne's backslide on Omega
matches.note: A non-title tag match pitting manager Chris Wheeling and Richard Masterson's own team against Cobra and his young partner; Wheeling and Valenkov kept beating down Cobra after the pinfall, Thunder Bombing him through the broken announce table, until Omega walked away from a screaming Masterson and fired him on camera.
